# coolify_tags (Data Source)

Lists Coolify team tags. Requires Coolify >= v4.2.0.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coolify_tags" "all" {}

output "tag_names" {
  value = [for t in data.coolify_tags.all.tags : t.name]
}
```
